subject: statistics: enable the auto-analysis priority queue (#51537)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs parent, focused on `pkg/sessionctx/variable` and `pkg/statistics/handle/autoanalyze/*`. Main changes are enabling `tidb_enable_auto_analyze_priority_queue` by default, extracting auto-analysis window parsing into `exec.ParseAutoAnalysisWindow`, and adding explicit time-window gating to the priority-queue refresher rebuild/pick flow; Bazel deps are updated accordingly. Call chain `HandleAutoAnalyze` -> `refresher.RebuildTableAnalysisJobQueue` (transaction-wrapped) -> `PickOneTableAndAnalyzeByPriority` preserves restricted SQL execution and respects the configured time window; no Blocker/High correctness, consistency, compatibility, or concurrency issues found. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`; priority-queue-based auto-analyze remains the direction (eventually always-on), with no later fix indicating a latent Blocker/High bug in this commit.
